items.title: 14.15 Fiza se mutalliq qawaneen aur zawabit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.15 heading, printed page 318.

blocks.text: Pakistan mein air pollution ko qawaneen aur zawabit (laws and regulations, 14.15.1) aur emission kam karne ke khaas iqdamat (measures, 14.15.2) ke zariye control kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Jab pollution kam karne ki technologies maujood hain to qawaneen ki zaroorat kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Converters, filters aur scrubbers lagane par paisa lagta hai, aur pollution phailane wale yeh kharch tab tak nahi karte jab tak emission ke standards lazmi na hon. Qawaneen had (limit) muqarrar karte hain, use lazmi banate hain aur khilaf-warzi par saza dete hain, taake technologies waqai istemal hon.

items: Air pollution qawaneen aur zawabit aur khaas control iqdamat se control hoti hai.
